column1: # ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES.17 slice 9 — the SV corpus transition set (PGEN-ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES-0032)
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The slice-9 admission flip changed `generated/systemverilog_parser.rs`, so the
# tracked corpus characterization is stale by its own staleness rule. The PROMOTION of that oracle is a
# separate unit (`SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13h`) because it is an atomic cascade that moves a published number.
# This file is the measurement that unit starts from, made DURABLE: the full re-run lives under
# `rust/target/`, which is git-ignored, so a fresh session would otherwise have to rediscover the delta
# rather than verify it (`CI-PARITY-GATE-ROT.29` acceptance (e)).
# HOW IT WAS PRODUCED — `stimuli/run_external_corpus.sh sv` at the TRACKED parameters (60s, 8 jobs, no
# cap) with `PGEN_CORPUS_OUT_DIR` set, joined per-path against the tracked `results.tsv`. ~4 minutes of
# parse; re-derivable rather than irreplaceable, which is why only the DELTA is tracked and not the
# 16336-row result set.
# THE HEADLINE, DERIVED FROM THE ROWS BELOW:
#   16336 files: pass 9762 -> 9774, fail 6574 -> 6562, timeout 0, crash 0
#   12 OBSERVED-verdict transitions, ALL fail->pass. ZERO pass->fail.  (the table below now carries
#   13 rows: the 13th moved its ADJUDICATION without moving its observed verdict — see the
#   correction block immediately after this headline, which is why the original 303 was wrong)
#   6 convert `divergence:unexplained_rejects_valid` -> `match`
#   6 are `deferred:chained_only` and STAY deferred — their verdict improved and the bar cannot see it
#   `accepts-invalid` UNCHANGED at 21 — the widened admission accepted no new invalid SV
# ⛔⛔ CORRECTED 2026-08-14 BY `SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13h` — THE BAR IS 302, NOT 303, AND THE ERROR IS IN
# THE JOIN THIS FILE IS BUILT ON. Promoting the oracle re-derived the manifest and found a
# THIRTEENTH moved row, appended below: `sv2v test/core/string_byte_order.sv` is `fail` on BOTH
# sides, so a per-path join on the OBSERVED verdict — which is how this table was produced — cannot
# see it. Its ADJUDICATION moved anyway: the file is
#     localparam b = 64'("abcd"); … localparam e = 32'("abcd"); … `include "string_byte_order.vh"
# so before the flip the parse died on the size cast at line 3, ahead of anything the preprocessor
# could reach, and `.12a`'s positional rule called that `unexplained_rejects_valid`. After the flip
# both casts parse and the furthest position advances to the `` `include `` at line 7 ⇒
# `explained_svpp_include`. ⭐ It is a THIRTEENTH GAIN from the same fix, invisible to a pass/fail
# join because the row has a second, independent blocker behind the one that was fixed.
#   ⇒ `divergence:unexplained_rejects_valid` 288 -> 281 (SEVEN out, not six)
#   ⇒ `divergence:explained_svpp_include`    139 -> 140
#   ⇒ axis-2 bar 309 -> 302   (281 rejects-valid + 21 accepts-invalid)
# ⛔ THE LESSON, because it generalises past this row: a corpus delta joined on the pass/fail verdict
# measures only the rows that CROSSED it. Adjudication classes are decided positionally as well, so
# the honest join is over the MANIFEST — `(suite, relpath) -> (observed, adjudication)` — which is
# what `.13h` used and what any future promotion must use.
